payload.title: The arbiter weighing and anchor briefs print tool_id, run_id, finding_id and judgment_group_id as raw prompt lines outside any untrusted block, although the seat brief treats the same finding_id as text written by whatever produced the finding.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:105-120 (the seat brief puts finding_id inside an untrusted_finding block and says the id is the words of whatever produced the finding)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:957-962 (the weighing brief prints the four identity values as plain lines, outside every untrusted block)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1135-1138 (the anchor brief prints the same four lines raw)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:87-102 (judgment_group_id is built from the finding id whenever no fingerprint exists)
aria-kernel/tests/test_j3_every_split_weighed.py:276-301 (the J3 hostile-text test exercises a seat rationale only; no test puts hostile text in an identity value)
payload.rule_violated: Trust-boundary discipline of text_safety.untrusted_block: text a producer wrote reaches a prompt only inside an untrusted block (the seat brief's own stated doctrine, ARIA-MEDIUM-826 for paths).
payload.notes: A finding id containing a newline (the seat brief's comment says the id is the producer's words, including a model's claim about an attacker-writable repository) is printed raw in the arbiter brief, so it can plant its own prompt lines, for example a forged seat line or an instruction, outside every untrusted block and with the standing of the kernel's own text. The seat brief wraps the same value; the arbiter brief does not. The arbiter holds Read and Grep only, so the stake is a steered weighing, not execution, and whether a producer can emit a newline-bearing id was not shown. Close condition: The four identity values are rendered inside one untrusted block (or refused when outside a kernel grammar) in the weighing and anchor briefs, and a test mirrors the SMUGGLED-instruction test with a newline-bearing finding_id and asserts it never appears outside an untrusted span. Plan row: J3 (the F0.7 exit). Verified at head 3451f5c3fc of open pull request #2135; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
